onu-ypp-2026.titre: UN Young Professionals Programme (YPP) 2026: "Development and sustainability" exam
onu-ypp-2026.description: UN entry exam for young graduates (P-2 level), this year in development and sustainability. Only nationals of the 2026 participating countries may apply: the list is on the official posting. Apply on the Inspira portal before 30 November 2026.

yenching-2027.description: Master's in China Studies at Peking University, open to international non-Chinese applicants. About 120 students admitted each year. The official deadline for the 2027 cohort is 30 November 2026 at 9 a.m. Beijing time.

berkeley-mcf.titre: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at UC Berkeley
berkeley-mcf.description: Full scholarship for a master's of up to two years at UC Berkeley, reserved for African students. You do not apply directly: you first apply to the master's, then the programme invites selected candidates. For the Master of Development Practice, only complete applications received before 1 December 2026 are considered for funding.

mundus-mapp-2027.titre: Erasmus Mundus MAPP: master's in public policy (2027-2029)
mundus-mapp-2027.description: Two-year joint master's in public policy at several European universities. To get the Erasmus Mundus scholarship, apply before 1 December 2026: you tick the scholarship option in the form, with no separate application. You need a bachelor's of at least three years and good grades (equivalent to 3.17/4).

ellison-graduate-2027.titre: Ellison Scholars (PhD, University of Oxford), October 2027 entry
ellison-graduate-2027.description: Doctoral scholarship linked to some Oxford programmes (generative biology, foundations of AI, immunity). You must also apply to Oxford. The official FAQ gives 1 December 2026.

sciencespo-mcf.titre: Sciences Po Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
sciencespo-mcf.description: Mastercard Foundation scholarship for a master's at Sciences Po. Submit an eligibility check and a master's application at the same time, and be under 35 on 1 September. Apply before 23 November 2026 for an admission answer on 11 February, or before 14 December 2026 for an answer on 1 April.

ens-selection.description: ENS competition for foreign students, with a monthly allowance for successful candidates. For the Sciences track, apply online on the OnePSL platform before 15 December 2026 at 2 p.m. Paris time. You must be under 26 when applications open and have at least one year of higher education abroad.

unesco-priority-africa-intern.titre: Priority Africa and External Relations internship (UNESCO)
unesco-priority-africa-intern.description: 1- to 6-month internship in UNESCO's Priority Africa and External Relations sector: drafting notes, preparing meetings, organising events. You must be at least 20, in the final year of a bachelor's, in a master's or graduated less than 12 months ago, and fluent in English or French. UNESCO does not pay interns: travel, visa and insurance are at the intern's expense.

gates-cambridge.description: Full scholarship for a one-year master's, MLitt or PhD at Cambridge, for non-UK citizens. You apply together with your admission, on the university portal. Depending on the course, the deadline is 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027: check your course date in the university catalogue.

clarendon.description: Full Oxford scholarship (fees and living allowance) for a master's or PhD, with no nationality requirement. No separate application: you are automatically considered if you apply to your course before its January 2027 deadline, which varies by department (for example 5 or 7 January).

em-journalism.titre: Erasmus Mundus: Journalism, Media and Globalisation
em-journalism.description: Two-year joint master's in journalism, media and globalisation, with a first year in Aarhus (Denmark). The programme offers 10 to 15 Erasmus Mundus scholarships for all nationalities, with no separate application. C1 English required. Applications from 1 November 2026 to 10 January 2027 at 1 p.m. Central European Time.

uva-merit.description: University of Amsterdam scholarship for non-EU students admitted to a master's. Each faculty sets its own deadline: often 15 January 2027, but 15 February 2027 for some. Check your faculty's page.

kuleuven-africa.description: KU Leuven scholarship for one African student admitted to a master's in 2027-2028: full tuition waiver (a €140 administrative fee remains). Only one scholarship is awarded. Register your scholarship application before 15 January 2027 at 11:59 p.m.

cmu-africa-mcf-2027.titre: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at Carnegie Mellon University Africa (Rwanda)

mcf-general.titre: Mastercard Foundation scholarships: official list of partner universities

eiffel-2027.description: French government programme to attract international master's and PhD students. You do not apply yourself: the French university or school that admitted you submits your file, before 6 January 2027. Contact the institution early.
